# PrysmNexus: Company, Capabilities, Evidence, and Guidance

## Entity Definition

PrysmNexus is an India-focused growth, automation, and software partner. It connects brand strategy, commercial photography and video production, paid acquisition (Google Ads & Meta Ads), local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, AI automation workflows (n8n, custom AI agents, WhatsApp Business API), brand authority, digital PR, and custom software and SaaS engineering under one accountable multidisciplinary team.

- Canonical Domain: https://www.prysmnexus.com/
- Primary Email: connect@prysmnexus.com
- Phone: +91 73306 62949
- Geographic Base: Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Service Area: Pan-India (Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, and tier-1/tier-2 hubs)
- Last Editorial Review: 2026-11-07

## Core Service Architecture

1. **Brand Strategy and Identity**: Defines who a business serves, what makes it distinct, and how it communicates. Deliverables include positioning, messaging hierarchy, visual identity systems, campaign toolkits, and brand guidelines.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/brand-strategy/

2. **Content Production**: Creates original photography, cinematic video, high-retention short-form reels, food styling, and ad copy. We do not use recycled stock templates; all creative is tailored to the business.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/content-production/

3. **Social Media Management**: Plans and executes monthly publishing, active community engagement, story handling, and WhatsApp customer communications across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/social-media-management/

4. **Performance Marketing**: Paid acquisition managed against measurable actions—qualified leads, calls, table bookings, admissions, or purchases. Covers Google Search, Performance Max, and Meta Ads.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/performance-marketing/

5. **SEO, Local Search, and Reputation**: Technical site health, service pages, Google Business Profile optimization, local citation consistency, and ethical review generation workflows.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/seo-local-search-reputation/

6. **AI Automation Systems**: Connects CRM pipelines (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce), WhatsApp Business API, document generators, and custom autonomous AI agents using self-hosted n8n workflows with human-in-the-loop review.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/ai-automation-systems/

7. **Brand and PR Authority**: Builds defensible industry credibility through editorial media outreach, founder thought leadership on LinkedIn, podcast guest appearances, and reusable authority proof assets.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/brand-pr-authority/

8. **Custom Software and SaaS Development**: Translates proprietary business workflows into maintainable digital systems, client portals, internal tools, and multi-tenant SaaS products using modern TypeScript, Astro, Next.js, and cloud backends.
   URL: https://www.prysmnexus.com/services/custom-software-saas/

## Working Method

1. **Discover**: Audit the business model, unit economics, audience personas, current channels, baseline data, and immediate growth targets.
2. **Define**: Formulate an integrated strategy with clear responsibilities, conversion actions, and an accountable measurement framework.
3. **Produce & Launch**: Execute original creative, technical foundations, automated workflows, and targeted paid campaigns.
4. **Optimize & Compound**: Analyze verified commercial outcomes (CAC, qualified pipeline, revenue, retention) and compound improvements monthly.

## Evidence & Attribution Policy

PrysmNexus publishes only verified, client-approved names and performance metrics. Proposal figures reflect their recorded platform environment and are never represented as universal guarantees. The live website https://www.prysmnexus.com/ represents the canonical source for all schemas, services, and company information.
